images.alt: Het bericht uit Chloës huis — 1 Korinthiërs 1:11; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 1 Corinthians 1:11: Paul has received a report from people of Chloe’s household about quarrels among the Corinthians. Show two ordinary adult messengers seated with Paul in a modest first-century Roman provincial home, one messenger seriously recounting the divisions while Paul listens with concern. No Chloe herself required, no claim to exact portraits, no written labels or slogans. Three adult people with clearly separate limbs. The content is the report being received, not an imagined physical fight.

images.alt: Timotheüs is naar Korinthe gestuurd — 1 Korinthiërs 4:17; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 1 Corinthians 4:17, Paul sends Timothy to remind the Corinthians of his ways in Christ. Show an older adult Paul at the doorway of a first-century house warmly speaking to younger adult Timothy, who has a simple shoulder travel bag and walking staff and is preparing to depart. Both fully clothed in plain modest robes. A calm commissioning scene with no travel map, no Roman official, no modern objects. Do not identify Timothy as a literal child: beloved son is spiritual language.
